title: Static trust lists
description: Restates HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management; RFC 7517 JSON Web Key.

statements.label: Static trust lists
statements.requirement: The trust store SHALL load DSCs from PEM and DER, for tests, pinned bilateral or national lists, and fully offline deployments.

sources.quote: the file format of this trusted list may vary, e.g., it can be a signed JWKS
